import sys

def count_inversions(p):
    n = len(p)
    inversions = 0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            if p[i] > p[j]:
                inversions += 1
    return inversions

def min_operations_to_one_inversion(p):
    n = len(p)
    current_inversions = count_inversions(p)
    
    if current_inversions == 1:
        return 0
    
    # Try to find the minimum number of swaps to get exactly one inversion
    min_swaps = float('inf')
    
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            # Swap p[i] and p[j]
            p[i], p[j] = p[j], p[i]
            new_inversions = count_inversions(p)
            if new_inversions == 1:
                min_swaps = min(min_swaps, 1)
            elif new_inversions == 2:
                min_swaps = min(min_swaps, 2)
            # Swap back to restore the original permutation
            p[i], p[j] = p[j], p[i]
    
    return min_swaps

    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read

        result = min_operations_to_one_inversion(p)
